prompt: At a desert excavation site, a paleontologist is kneeling inside a large dig pit, carefully brushing dust from a massive dinosaur skull fossil. A partially uncovered rib cage fossil is next to the skull, and the skull is larger than the rib cage fossil. Behind the paleontologist stands a canvas tent. The paleontologist is holding a small brush. A colleague is standing outside the pit, looking down at the paleontologist and holding a clipboard and some pens. The brush the paleontologist is holding is shorter than the pens. The colleague is pointing at the rib cage. The paleontologist is facing the skull. In front of the dig pit, a plaster-covered fossil fragment rests on a wooden crate. The three water bottles are standing in a row next to the crate. The number of pens the colleague is holding is two more than the number of water bottles. A jeep is parked behind the tent and is taller than the tent.
